manageDeals.manualHelp: This meal deal will not appear on events unless you activate it in the “Schedule” tab.
eventTypes.title: Event types
eventTypes.missingTitle: Event types are not switched on yet.

eventTypes.noTypes: You have no event types yet, so every event uses your usual setup.
eventTypes.name: Name
eventTypes.matchTitle: Do you want to match “{name}” to Standard?
eventTypes.matchKeeps: Whatever you changed on a single event’s dashboard stays as it is, and this type’s prices do not change.

eventTypes.phone.standardSetup: Your usual setup: it applies to every event with no type.

eventTypes.phone.noMenuItems: No menu items yet: add them in Menu › Items.
eventTypes.newType.title: New event type
eventTypes.newType.help: Tap a name or type one. It starts as a copy of Standard, and if you change Standard later, this one will not change. Afterwards you can change whatever you like.
eventTypes.select.label: Event type
eventTypes.select.usual: {name} is the usual one for this place.
eventTypes.errors.noVans: This food truck has no vehicle to change.
privateEvents.grid.linkRowLabel: Take orders with private link and QR code
privateEvents.grid.columnTitle: The built-in Private type. It cannot be renamed, moved or deleted.
privateEvents.form.help: It shows on your schedule as “Private event” with only the date and times: never the address, the map or Village Foodie.
privateEvents.form.linkPromise: Guests order with a private link and a QR code; you will get them once you save.
privateEvents.form.nameHelp: Guests see it at the top of the ordering page.
privateEvents.form.previewNote: How it shows on your schedule: no venue, town or postcode.
privateEvents.form.needsTimes: Add a start time and an end time: a private event taking orders by link needs them.
privateEvents.link.title: Private link and QR code
privateEvents.link.label: Private link
privateEvents.link.newLinkConfirm: Do you want to make a new link? The current link will stop working immediately, and the QR codes you have already printed will stop working too.
privateEvents.link.newLinkHelp: Use this if the link has reached where it should not have. The current link stops working immediately, and so do printed QR codes.
privateEvents.link.newLinkFailed: A new link could not be made.
privateEvents.link.offNotice: Ordering by private link is off for this event, so there is no link to share. The event still shows on your schedule as “Private event”.
privateEvents.cards.blurb: Place the order and pay from your phone. We will call you by name when it is ready.
privateEvents.noSinglePost: Private events do not get their own post: they appear on your weekly poster as “Private event”.
privateEvents.confirmToPrivate: This hides the address and takes the event off the map. Guests will need the private link to order.
privateEvents.confirmFromPrivate: This makes the event public: its address and map pin will show, and the private link will stop working.
